gloss: desperate; frantic; with all one's might

definitions.gloss: desperation; frantic effort; as if one's life depended on it
definitions.explanation: Struggling or working with every ounce of strength, as if one's life were at stake. Most often used adverbially as {死|し}に{物狂|ものぐる}いで (desperately, like mad).

examples.japanese: {死|し}に{物狂|ものぐる}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: I ran like my life depended on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{死|し}に{物狂|ものぐる}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}した→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Before the entrance exams I studied like mad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧{死|し}に{物狂|ものぐる}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: To save the company, every employee kept up a desperate effort.

notes:
Built from ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (dying) + {物狂|ものぐる}い (madness). Stronger and more dramatic than ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {死|し}に{物狂|ものぐる}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: desperately, frantically
- {死|し}に{物狂|ものぐる}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: a desperate effort
- {死|し}に{物狂|ものぐる}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work like crazy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧: desperate, frantic — the everyday word
- ⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧: with all one's effort — positive and calm, without the desperation
